title: fix: resolve critical and high severity issues (images, auth, security, SEO, legal pages)
body: ## Summary Fixes all **Critical** and **High** severity issues identified during the full site analysis. Changes span images, authentication/security, SEO, legal pages, and code quality. ### Images (Critical) - Replaced 9 incorrect/mismatched destination images with proper free-licensed photos: - `hero-slider-2.jpg`: Swimming pool → Kaaba with pilgrims (Umrah) - `tour-hajj.jpg`: Swimming pool → Kaaba/Hajj crowd - `tour-baghdad.jpg`: US desert/VW van → Iraqi mosque in Kirkuk - `tour-malaysia.jpg`: Paris bridge → Petronas Towers at night - `baghdad-gallery-1.jpg`: Europe map → Al-Kadhimiya Mosque, Baghdad - `baghdad-gallery-2.jpg`: Dubai skyline → Erbil Citadel, Iraq - `malaysia-gallery-1.jpg`: Big Ben/London → Petronas Towers sunset - `malaysia-gallery-2.jpg`: Wrong image → Aerial Petronas Towers - `singapore-gallery-2.jpg`: Wrong → Merlion statue, Singapore ### Security (Critical + High) - **Shared auth utility**: Extracted duplicated `checkAuth()` from 9 API files into `app/lib/auth.server.ts` - **Password-as-token fix**: Login now returns a SHA-256 hashed token instead of the raw password - **Password inconsistency**: Standardized fallback password (`admin123` in login vs `TravelWings2025!` elsewhere) - **Rate limiting**: Added to login (5/min), inquiry (10/min), newsletter (5/min) endpoints - **XSS protection**: Added `app/lib/sanitize.ts` — sanitizes tracking IDs and user-generated blog content before `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`. Admin-controlled custom head/body code is intentionally NOT sanitized (it's behind auth and designed for script injection like Facebook Pixel, Hotjar, etc.) ### SEO (High) - Tour detail page now shows dynamic title (e.g., "Umrah Package 2025 - Travel Wings USA") instead of static "Tour Details" ### UX (High) - Created proper **Privacy Policy** and **Terms of Service** pages at `/privacy-policy` and `/terms-of-service` - Fixed dead footer links (`href="#"`) to point to new legal pages ## Review & Testing Checklist for Human - [ ] **Admin login**: Log in at `/admin` with your password — the token system changed, so verify login works and all admin tabs (Leads, Blogs, Media, Categories, SEO) load correctly - [ ] **Images**: Check homepage hero slider, Hajj/Umrah/Baghdad/Malaysia tour pages, and their galleries — all images should show correct destinations - [ ] **Legal pages**: Visit `/privacy-policy` and `/terms-of-service` — verify content is appropriate and footer links work - [ ] **Rate limiting**: Try submitting the contact form or newsletter more than 10/5 times rapidly — should get a 429 error - [ ] **Social media links**: These were intentionally left unchanged per your request — update them when ready ### Notes - Baghdad images use Iraqi landmarks (Kirkuk mosque, Erbil Citadel) since free Baghdad-specific photos are extremely limited - The auth system maintains backward compatibility — existing admin sessions using the old token format will still work - Social media links are untouched as requested ("mai baad mai krlu gha") - All images are from free sources (Unsplash, Wikimedia Commons) and stored locally — no external image links Link to Devin session: https://app.devin.ai/sessions/c037ac9d227e4aa5b296c878bb2a044d Requested by: @JohnWick3323 ---
